summary: Review of 1.24.25 sheet editing (SHEET_EDIT, SHEET_FORMAT, SHEET_ROWS) and POWERW's check. refs: 696 cases (shift, move), 653 agree with Excel, 43 differ; the oracle (an independent tokenizer) agreed with LibreOffice 24.2 headless (copyRange, insertCells, removeRange) on all 696. grid: 254 cases replayed in jsdom, 182 agree, 70 differ, 2 unverified. power: 67 cases, 36 agree, 31 not (ok 36, misfire 13, miss 10, fires with a wrong line 6, misfire (same number) 2). ui: 15 Chromium checks. Differences by cause (grid): sort-dates-as-text 6, decimals-from-general 6, carry-into-counts 6, sort-text-collation 5, carry-into-logicals 5, whole-row-refs 4, cut-paste-refs 3, tsv-leading-quote 3, fmt-empty-lost 3, fmt-typed-date-ignored 3, no-ctrl-arrows 2, active-cell-is-last 2, paste-no-tiling 2, cut-clears-at-once 2, ref-past-z 2, sort-logicals 2, sort-hash-text-as-error 2, sort-one-column-scrambles 2, delete-range-clears-format 2, ctrl-a-used-range 1, no-header-select 1, second-paste-after-cut 1, tsv-spaces-blanked 1, reversed-range-dollar 1, sort-bracket-negative 1, sort-errors-ordered 1, sort-key-left-column 1. Most important: sorting one selected column scrambles rows; cut-and-paste leaves formulas pointing at the emptied cells and empties the cells at once; formats on empty cells are lost on insert/delete; Delete on a range clears formats; whole-row references (2:2) never move; inserting columns makes references past Z that the engine reads as column A (a wrong total, no error); dates and times sort as text; the carried money/percent look lands on counts and on TRUE (shown $1.00); a typed date ignores a date format; more/fewer decimals start from 0 decimals and drop a typed $ or %; TSV with a cell starting with a lone quote collapses the rest of the paste into one cell; no tiling on paste; typing after selecting a range goes to the last cell, not the active one; on a phone, Select range stays on after Copy so a paste can fill source-to-target. POWERW check: renames every POWER( in a question mentioning power, an energy word and a time, so right formulas with squares or 10^3 are changed (13 wrong lines handed to a model, 2 harmless); it hands back the model's own numbers unconverted for kJ/kWh/minutes (wrong line), keeps only the first line of a two-line reply, and misses wattage, 'an hour', ms, days, 'raised', 'power of 2'. Undo/redo: 22 sequences (typing, fill, paste, sort, insert, format, freeze, cut, delete) all came back exactly.
